_comment: The whole of Zurgo and Ojutai's printed third line, as a test-pool card, for tests/unit/test_zurgo_and_ojutai.py. The real card is zurgo_and_ojutai in data/cards/auto/; it was not in the registry when this was written, and the behaviour gate stops before combat, so this is the shape standing in for it: identical trigger and effects, its own id and name. t_zao_plain is a Dragon with no text, so a swing can be shown to carry a second Dragon into the damagers binding; t_zao_ogre is the non-Dragon the filter has to leave out.

cards.name: Test Zurgo Shape
cards.oracle_text:
Flying, haste
Test Zurgo Shape has hexproof as long as it entered this turn.
Whenever one or more Dragons you control deal combat damage to a player or battle, look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order. You may return one of those Dragons to its owner's hand.
